sentences.ar: جحا اشترى كيس بصل من السوق.
sentences.en: Juha bought a bag of onions from the market.
The road was long and the bag heavy.

sentences.ar: كل شوي كان يوقف ويعد البصلات.
sentences.en: Every little while he would stop and count the onions.
Someone asked him: why are you counting?

sentences.ar: قال جحا: كل ما بعد، بنسى إني تعبان.
sentences.en: Juha said: every time I count, I forget that I am tired.
